name: children-of-morta
features: 4:3 menu, HUD, loading, and splash-screen CanvasScaler references
4:3 center-cropped Android static splash without stretching
isolated Firebase Analytics event cleanup while preserving FirebaseApp initialization
hidden More Games cross-promotion while preserving purchases and online services

notes: Unity objects are selected by CanvasScaler script identity, structure, object cohort, and original-or-patched resolution.
The AArch64 library is constrained by ELF mapping, canonical SHA-256, and exact original-or-patched bytes at every target.
FirebaseInitProvider remains untouched so Remote Config and other Firebase-backed game services can initialize.
Billing, Play Pass, cloud features, Play Games, EOS, and Firebase Remote Config are retained.
Source-specific branding cleanup remains optional and framework-owned.
